description: Resolve any ticker and see its price in USD and EUR in one command — stocks, crypto, and forex, no API key.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0 Safari/537.36

tools.name: market_quote
tools.description: Get last price and currency for a fully-qualified EXCHANGE:TICKER. Required: symbol. Optional: fields, no-404 (default: true). Returns the Quote.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Fully-qualified ticker, e.g. NASDAQ:AAPL or BINANCE:BTCUSDT

params.name: no-404
params.description: Return empty instead of 404 for unknown symbols

tools.name: symbols_search
tools.description: Search symbols by text (returns exchange, type, currency). Required: text. Optional: search-type, exchange, hl (default: 0) (plus 2 more).

params.name: text
params.description: Search text, e.g. AAPL or Bitcoin

params.name: search-type
params.description: Restrict by type: stock, crypto, forex, index, fund (blank = all)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Restrict to an exchange, e.g. NASDAQ
